title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion - University of California on 1973-11-17

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1973 performance with a smoking Playing > Uncle John’s Band > Morning Dew suite and a fiery Here Comes Sunshine.
ai_review.review: The show is lauded as a tight, exuberant set from the peak ‘73/’74 era, highlighted by the seamless Playing→UJB→Morning Dew sequence, soaring Here Comes Sunshine, and a scorching China‑Cat‑Sunflower → I Know You Rider. The Ashley remaster delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality with Keith’s jazzy organ work front‑and‑center and Bill’s drums crisp in the mix, making the recording as compelling as the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are 5‑star, praising both the musical brilliance and the pristine soundboard remaster; the consistency and volume of feedback give a very high confidence in an exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered by Jay Ashley, described as crisp, beautiful, pristine throughout with only minor early‑mix bass bury; overall clear and balanced.

standout_songs: Playing > Uncle John's Band > Morning Dew > Uncle John's Band > Playing
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, seamless transitions—especially the second‑set suite—create a flowing, high‑energy journey; first set holds its own with strong jams and vocal harmonies.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is praised as perfect and his solos on China‑Cat‑Sunflower → Rider are highlighted as stellar.
band_member_comments.Phil: Solid bass foundation, though slightly buried in the mix early in the show before finding balance later.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s organ drives the jazzy New Orleans vibe; Donna contributes memorable harmonies.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann is described as tight and prominent in the mix.
